payload.entry: Baseline 2026-10-23 as bryan: ss shows 0.0.0.0:8052 (multivisor-rpc) and 0.0.0.0:8100 (multivisor). Apollo TCP to 100.87.31.114:8052 and :8100 both open. Live files are ~/.config/supervisor -> ~/db/home/.config/supervisor; chezmoi does not track them. Only consumer of 8052 is local Multivisor (url=localhost:8052). Remote consumer of 8100 is chezmoi alias multivisor-cli --url athena:8100. hera:8051/8052 kept: hera is absent from tailnet inventory, DNS, and tailscale status, with no retirement evidence. Decision: 8100 loopback+tailnet via dedicated nftables table matching iifname lo and tailscale0.

Unprivileged install done as bryan: install_user_supervisor.py patched ~/.config/supervisor/supervisord.conf and multivisor.conf (password preserved, hera URLs kept). Backups supervisord.conf.bob-cli-av.20261023T165548Z.pre and matching multivisor.conf. Restarted only user multivisor-rpc and supervisor:multivisor; root supervisor PIDs unchanged. verify_user_supervisor.py passed (user IPC bryan:bryan 0700, no TCP 8052, local 8100 401, authenticated login shows root@athena and bryan@athena running). Apollo 100.87.31.114:8052 connection refused; :8100 still open pending nftables boundary.
